candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 after ~2s because the order service's call to payment (/v1/authorizations) hits a transport ReadTimeout; payment is the slow downstream, while inventory/redis calls succeed quickly.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency metrics/logs not observed; cause of payment slowness (saturation vs. dependency) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated checkout 502s driven by ReadTimeout on POST payment /v1/authorizations, while inventory and redis calls return 200 quickly. Gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 502s and p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms order depends on payment. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics during the incident window
Payment service logs or spans showing where the ~2s is spent
